Answer: C
Reason: The provided axial CT image demonstrates a prominent soft tissue mass in the left paratracheal/mediastinal region (left hilum area) adjacent to the trachea, which correlates with the symptom of dysphonia due to recurrent laryngeal nerve involvement or direct tracheal compression by tracheal squamous cell carcinoma. On a chest X-ray, this pathology would manifest as enlargement of the left hilum or superior mediastinum.
